events.title: In the Room: Sixty Years on the Front Lines of History
events.description: Roosevelt understood the camera before most politicians did. He posed in buckskin in the Badlands, stood with John Muir at Yosemite, and left behind one of the most photographed lives of his century. David Hume Kennerly has spent sixty years doing the other half of that job — from the Vietnam battlefields that earned him the Pulitzer, to the Ford White House, to nearly every administration since. The special exhibition, drawn from his book In the Room, opens at the Library in October.

extra.room: Microsoft Gallery in the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library
hours: Dec 02–Jan 10: Sun, Wed – Sat 10:00 am – 4:00 pm
